headline: Potato harvest window opens; tip canes before 8 AM.
weather_notes: Complete all garden work before 8 AM through Tuesday — Heat Advisory active through Monday night with 100–104°F highs closing every afternoon window.
Run zone 1 early tomorrow morning — 3 days without irrigation entering 104°F today is past the 1-day rewater threshold for zone 1 beds.
Shade e1–e4 tomato transplants by midday today — 36-day plants under back-to-back 100°F+ days risk sunscald and flower drop.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 16 days overdue and 42 days of summer growth since the June 14 observation means canes are well past tipping height; before-8-AM is the only safe window under the active Heat Advisory.

suggested_tasks.title: Watch potato bags for dying tops
suggested_tasks.description: Yukon Gold at 68 days is entering the 65–80 day harvest window — check daily for yellowing or collapsing tops as the signal to stop hilling and begin harvest.

suggested_tasks.title: Check w4 onions for harvest readiness
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star onions at 92 days are 3–5 days from typical maturity — look daily for softening necks and falling tops, then bend any still-upright stems to finish bulb curing.
